messages:
Alex (AE): FYI Acme just asked to add low-latency streaming sessions + BYO-KMS to the existing POC. They want 50 concurrent streams, 2s p95, and logs retained for 30 days. Asking if we can keep the same timeline (2 weeks) and pricing. :eyes:
Mira (SE): Streaming + BYO-KMS is a big scope change. Do they mean server-sent events streaming or gRPC bidi? Also 2s p95 for 50 streams depends a lot on model choice and batch settings.
Jordan (CSM): Customer claims it's required for demo UX. They also want E2E encryption with their HSM. They're pushing to keep timeline.
Sam (Infra Eng): Short answer: BYO-KMS + 30d logs => extra onboarding (KMS integration + key rotation policy) and storage/cost impacts. For streaming, our hosted routing can do SSE, but sustained 50 concurrent low-latency sessions probably needs Dedicated or a Private staging deployment.
Irene (Security): From a compliance standpoint BYO-HSM keys in customer KMS is OK but we need a control plane exception and an encrypted-in-transit check. Need an updated security questionnaire entry and demo mitigations. We should flag: no plaintext key material stored, key access audit trail required.
Alex (AE): What are rough deltas on cost and infra timeline if we accept? Need a short blurb for legal and pricing so they don't escalate.
Sam (Infra Eng): Roughly: Dedicated pool reservation for the POC (1-2 gpus) or a private lane will add ~2-3 days for provisioning plus network setup. KMS integration: 3-5 days (depending on cert exchange + HSM vendor). Storage for logs: 30d @ their qps ~ estimate +$X/day — I'll run numbers but call it "moderate".
Mira (SE): Also we need acceptance criteria. If they insist on 2s p95, propose an eval plan: (1) canonical prompt set for streaming messages (we need sample prompts), (2) synthetic concurrency test (50 clients for 10 min), (3) token-level latency traces. We should version the model and quantization profile used.
Jordan (CSM): I'll ask the customer for the streaming protocol (SSE vs gRPC) and sample prompts today. Also pushing to confirm whether they can accept an interim SLA: 2.5s p95 for hosted, 2s p95 for Dedicated.
Alex (AE): Good. Can someone draft the pricing delta and an optional POC addendum? I want one doc to share with legal + procurement.
Sam (Infra Eng): I'll draft infra notes and a cost bump estimate. Need to know model family (LlamaX-13B vs LlamaX-33B) — bigger model increases latency.
Irene (Security): I'll update the security questionnaire response: note limited key access, audit logs required, and a recommended network diagram. Also we should request an ATO checklist for demo access.
Mira (SE): For the eval prompts, here's a quick starter set (we'll refine):
```
# streaming_prompt_set_v1
- user: "Live summarization of incoming support chat messages"
- user: "Real-time extraction of action items from a transcript"
- user: "Short rewriting for SMS delivery (max 160 chars)"
```
These cover throughput, latency sensitivity, and short-form output.
Jordan (CSM): Customer replied: they prefer gRPC bidi. They can provide sample transcripts by EOD. Also they asked if we support BYO KMS in hosted mode.
Alex (AE): @Irene can we support BYO-KMS in hosted mode with key wrapping? If not, state it clearly.
Irene (Security): Hosted BYO-KMS is possible if we implement key wrapping and do not persist customer keys. But that requires an architecture change + legal signoff. Short timeline risk. Private deployment (VPC) is the low-friction option for BYO-HSM.
Sam (Infra Eng): For now I'd recommend offering two paths: (A) Hosted + enclave key-wrapping prototype (longer lead, non-standard) or (B) Private/Dedicated POC with direct KMS integration (faster). Outline both in the addendum.
Alex (AE): Okay — Jordan please present both options to Acme and ask them to pick. Also ask if they're flexible on the 2s p95 or model size.
Jordan (CSM): On it. I'll push for Dedicated + model pegged to LlamaX-13B as a compromise.
Mira (SE): Action items I see: 1) Sam: infra cost/timeline estimate (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Irene: security questionnaire + hosted-vs-private recommendation (due EOD tomorrow). 3) Sam/Mira: shortlist of model/config recommended for 2s p95 at 50 streams (due +2 days). 4) Alex/Jordan: pricing addendum draft (due later today).
Sam (Infra Eng): Ack, starting infra runbook now. Note: network egress and cross-region latency may also affect p95 — need customer's region and network topology.
Jordan (CSM): I'll get region + transcripts and confirm whether they can accept Dedicated. Also will ask procurement about budget increase baseline.
Alex (AE): If they pick Dedicated, we can probably keep the 2-week timeline if they sign the addendum today. If they insist on hosted BYO-KMS, push a 4-week timeline.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: provision-dedicated-pool job queued (not executed until PO signed). :hammer_and_wrench:
Irene (Security): One more note — request a short-risk-acceptance doc from legal for the demo if hosted BYO is chosen. We need it before any key exchanges. :warning:
Alex (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate and send a concise email to Acme with the two paths, expected deltas, and the ask to pick by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
